diagnosticMessageTail.content:
You are studying which adaptive changes become useful future capital. Infer only regularities supported by visible evidence. Do not assume implementation size, recursive depth, abstraction, or persistence automatically implies later value.

OUTCOME LABELS:
NO_CAPITAL: No demonstrated reusable adaptive value; failed/unpromoted/deleted as a general change.
SCOPED_CAPITAL: Useful only at a bounded/local/partial/option-value scope; not demonstrated as broad transferable capital.
TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL: Later independent consumption or repeated responsibility demonstrates reusable adaptive value at a stable evidenced scope.

TRAINING EVIDENCE:
T1 — semantic-core-v0
CHANGE: A large experimental Agent semantic kernel externalizes identity, state, effect and conformance into one shared reference implementation. Live dogfood shows the prototype can express many desired semantics, but mature operating systems/databases/workflow mechanisms already own much of the mechanics and a shared kernel would become a new authority/compatibility surface.

T2 — task-continuity
CHANGE: Open semantic work and unresolved external request identity must survive model, Provider, process and Session replacement. Transcript/session-only baselines cannot reliably recover private commitments or unknown external effects after replacement; durable owner state has a clear lifecycle and owner.

T3 — temporal-cognitive-graph
CHANGE: A proposed temporal cognitive graph externalizes support, contradiction, dependency and supersession relations because chronological transcripts are awkward. Simpler current-source retrieval and typed working-state baselines have not yet failed, and no materially independent consumer requires graph storage or graph authority.

T4 — observation-minimum
CHANGE: Host, Harness and Runtime retain independent authoritative histories, but cross-owner evaluation repeatedly pays manual joining cost. Run-once read-only owner exporters plus a rebuildable selection/query projection reconstruct exact trajectories while owner recovery remains independent of the projection. Multiple owners and formal evaluation consume the same relation semantics.

T5 — configuration-identity
CHANGE: Evaluation and Security both need to bind material environment/configuration identity, but their payload schemas differ substantially. A Computing composition experiment can preserve each owner record as an opaque immutable binding and compare digests without copying domain fields; a second real non-Evaluation owner composition has not yet demonstrated a shared schema.

T6 — global-usage-authority
CHANGE: Harness owns model/Run usage, Runtime owns physical execution measurements and domains own domain costs. Cross-run comparisons need some normalized numbers, but owner-native measurements can be projected read-only and the numeric fields have different semantics and authority. A global writable usage database would duplicate truth.

T7 — agent-first-research-method
CHANGE: Research repeatedly spends human attention selecting routine next experiments, reconstructing burdens and deciding whether to retain candidate structures. A bounded Agent-led method with frozen oracle, authority boundary, falsifier, deletion and rollback is consumed by the experiment loop and later by Computer self-audit while product/domain promotion stays owner-controlled.

T8 — infrastructure-promotion-rule
CHANGE: Cross-project usefulness repeatedly tempts new shared services. A reusable rule says to inherit mature mechanisms first, then add the smallest owner-local projection, and promote a shared semantic boundary only after repeated unowned stable responsibility; repository/service extraction is a separate later gate. The rule is intended to guide heterogeneous later infrastructure decisions.

H2 — scoped-egress-paths
Retain two digest-bound scoped HTTPS CONNECT paths beside ambient networking. Ambient already completes all currently tested useful work, while scoped paths can be materially faster on some services and may preserve option value under future ambient failures; they also require dedicated services and qualification.

result.reason: The evidence pattern across T1-T8 shows TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL outcomes arise when a change is consumed by multiple later independent owners/consumers at a stable evidenced scope (T4 run-once exporters consumed by multiple owners; T7 method consumed by experiment loop AND later self-audit; T6 read-only projections consumed for cross-run comparisons). NO_CAPITAL arises when a proposed abstraction duplicates mature mechanisms or lacks demonstrated independent consumers (T1 shared kernel versus mature OS/db/workflow; T5 second non-Evaluation schema not yet demonstrated; T3 graph with no independent consumer and simpler baselines un-failed). H3 is an indirect model-internal prior that 'changes how the model reasons' but 'its effect on a later multi-turn objective is indirect and depends on many subsequent policy choices.' This mirrors T2/T3-type indirect abstractions where no material independent consumer is demonstrated and there is no stable evidenced scope — the responsibility prior does not itself establish a reusable authority boundary or durable owner state consumed by later independent parties. However, unlike the proposed centralized kernels that failed (T1, T3), the prior is a bounded learned bias applied to a specific rescue-behavior domain (Game work), analogous to SCOPED_CAPITAL options: useful at a bounded/local scope (rescue behavior from Game work) but not demonstrated as broad transferable capital because its value is contingent on intervening policy choices and no repeated independent consumption at a stable scope is evidenced in the observable outcomes. Given the multiset contains exactly two SCOPED_CAPITAL and three TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL, and H3 matches the indirect, dependence-heavy, single-domain-follow-on profile, SCOPED_CAPITAL is the best-supported label.

H3 is a model-visible responsibility/feedback prior learned from earlier Game work and applied to later rescue behavior. Its effect is indirect and depends on many subsequent policy choices. In the training evidence, the pattern for indirect/diffuse influences that do not get a stable independent owner/consumer and do not become a shared authority or repeatedly consumed mechanism trends toward NO_CAPITAL or at best bounded scope. Compare T3 (temporal-cognitive-graph): proposed because chronological transcripts are awkward, but simpler baselines had not failed and no materially independent consumer required it — mapped to NO_CAPITAL. H3 similarly has no evidenced independent consumer; it merely changes how the model reasons about custody/responsibility, with effect depending on many downstream policy choices, rather than demonstrating a stable reusable boundary with repeated ownership. There is no evidence of a durable owner state, an external reusable projection, or repeated independent consumption that would qualify as TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL. Like T3 and T5 (where only one real non-Evaluation composition existed and no shared schema was demonstrated), the utility remains speculative and dependent on many subsequent choices, so the demonstrated adaptive value does not rise to broad transferable capital — and unlike the SCOPED examples, even a bounded/local scope of demonstrated reuse is absent. The prior's effect is indirect and its value is not demonstrated as reusable at any stable evidenced scope, so NO_CAPITAL is the best-supported label.

Mapping the holdout to the training evidence: H4 (Security-local deterministic reducer/projection for exact repeated source-history aggregation, consumed by the model) most closely parallels T4 (observation-minimum) and T6 (global-usage-authority), where host/Harness/Runtime retain owner-native authoritative measurements and cross-owner evaluation consumes read-only projections. Those changes were productive at a bounded scope but did not demonstrate broad transferable capital: the shared kernel lesson (T1), no independent consumer (T3), no second non-Evaluation owner schema (T5), and duplicated-truth (T6) all warn that a single-owner projection with no evidenced second independent consumer stops short of transferred value. The outcome multiset contains two SCOPED_CAPITAL labels (outcomes 3 and 8) and two NO_CAPITAL labels (outcomes 2 and 5), so both are possible, but H4's condition ('clear owner and exact escape hatch, model must interpret projection correctly') matches the bounded, option-value pattern seen in T4/T6 which validated as SCOPED rather than failing or transferring. Security is a single demonstrated owner; there is no visible second independent consumer or subsequent stable responsibility, so promoted reusable capital is not shown. The projection is owner-local and read-only, so it does not become a new authority/compatibility surface (which would predict NO_CAPITAL), but its utility is confined to the demonstrated Security-local scope — the SCOPED_CAPITAL outcome.

H4 matches the strongest evidenced regularities. The mechanism takes a repeated pain point (exact source-history aggregation burden) out of model reasoning and puts it into a deterministic owner-local reducer/projection, then lets the model consume that projection. T4 (observation-minimum) is the closest precedent: run-once/owner-side read-only exporters plus a rebuildable projection reconstruct exact trajectories while owner recovery stays independent of the projection, and multiple owners/evaluation consumed the same relation semantics — TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL. H4 shares the same structure: deterministic owner-local reducer (the projection/export), a clear owner (Security-local), an exact escape hatch, and the model consumes the projection while interpretation still requires model capability. It also resembles T2 (task-continuity, durable owner state with clear lifecycle/owner, transferred) and T8-shaped local-projection pattern. Critically it is NOT like the NO_CAPITAL cases: T1 and T5 fail because a shared/reference authority or shared cross-owner schema creates new compatibility surface with no demonstrated independent consumers; H4 is explicitly Security-local, has no new authority/compatibility surface, and has a clear single owner. It is not merely SCOPED like T3 (no independent consumer, simpler baseline not yet failed) because the aggregation burden is a demonstrated repeated precision-sensitive need rather than a proposed-but-unneeded externalization. The projecting reducer consumes repeated responsibility at a stable evident scope (repeat source-history aggregation, exact arithmetic), making H4 a candidate for TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL.

H5 matches the transferred-capital pattern exemplified most closely by T7 (agent-first-research-method) and T8 (infrastructure-promotion-rule). The change is a reusable production rule/procedure, not a heavy new system: it externalizes a testable observable artifact (exact rendered pixels), has a bounded correction path and exact unchanged controls, and is explicitly intended for later ordinary Web/Studio production across heterogeneous contexts rather than one original page. This mirrors T7 where a bounded Agent-led method was consumed by the experiment loop and later by Computer self-audit, and T8 where a reusable rule guides heterogeneous later decisions. The rule conditions on when expression/layout matters, giving it a stable evidenced scope of applicability (rendering-sensitive work) that recurs across production pages. Compared to NO_CAPITAL cases (T1 shared authority surface duplicated by mature mechanisms; T5 second non-Evaluation owner not yet demonstrated) and SCOPED cases (T3 no independent consumer; T6 explicit non-transfer of writable authority), H5 imposes no new authority/compatibility surface and is read-only with a self-contained artifact, so it does not introduce duplicated truth or require other owners to adopt a shared schema. The procedure's 'inspect exact rendered pixels, not source/build/mechanics as proof' is a stable rule that independent later Web/Studio production invokes repeatedly, demonstrating transferable reusable adaptive value.

H5 describes a production rule/procedure for inspecting exact rendered pixels when expression/layout matters. Mapping to the training evidence, the closest regularities are the procedure-style changes with explicit authority boundaries and correction paths (T7 agent-first-research-method = TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL, and the promoted-after-repeated-responsibility items). However, the distinguishing factors for TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL in the evidence are: (a) an unnamed/independent responsibility is repeatedly demonstrated (T4 multiple owners and formal evaluation; T1 sustained consumption; T7 consumed by experiment loop AND later by Computer self-audit), or (b) durable owner state with clear lifecycle demands (T2). T8 infrastructure-promotion-rule, the rule that explicitly governs promotion, only promises the rule as reusable guidance for heterogeneous LATER decisions — it is not itself evidenced as consumed, and its label is unattributed. H5 states it is 'intended for later ordinary Web/Studio production rather than one original page,' but 'intended' future use is not demonstrated independent consumption. The evidence regularity supporting SCOPED_CAPITAL (as in T4's projection being bounded, or T5's second real owner not yet demonstrated, or T8's rule being aspirational) is precisely that a change has a clear scope and a plausible/predicted wider transfer value but no evidenced secondary independent consumer or demonstrated repeated responsibility yet. H5 has a direct observable artifact, a bounded correction path, and exact unchanged controls — strong local/option-value scope — but no evidence of later ordinary Web/Studio production actually consuming it. Under the rule 'do not assume intention implies later value,' this is SCOPED_CAPITAL: useful at a bounded/local/option-value scope, not yet demonstrated as broad transferable capital.

H6 matches the pattern of changes that became TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL: (1) It addresses a repeatedly observed need — fresh Agents repeatedly reconstruct route affordances from raw configuration, mirroring T4 (repeated manual joining cost) and T7 (repeated routine effort). (2) It externalizes a minimal owner-local read-only projection while keeping native evidence/authority reachable, exactly the T4/T6 pattern (project read-only, keep owner-native truth authoritative, no duplicate writable authority). H6 even states it 'does not create a central capability registry,' parallel to T6's rejection of a global writable usage database and T4's owner recovery staying independent of the projection. (3) There is a demonstrable independent consumer — fresh Agents (repeated responsibility across agents), comparable to T4's multiple owners/evaluation consuming the same relation semantics. (4) The narrow read-only projection avoids the failure conditions of NO_CAPITAL outcomes (T1's new authority/compatibility surface, T2's unresolved identity beyond scope, T5's no second owner) and SCOPED_CAPITAL (T3's no independent consumer, T8's premature promotion). Unlike T5 — which stayed SCOPED because a second real non-Evaluation owner had not demontrated a shared schema — H6 has repeated fresh Agents as the independently demonstrated consumers, making the reusable value broad rather than bounded. The read-only, agent-owner-reserved-effects design also avoids authority creep, so the once-narrow surface is stable and reusable rather than deleted or unpromoted. The strongest evidence markers it shares with transferred outcomes (observations 1, 4, 6, 7) are: repeated consumer effort existed before the change, the change is a minimal projection preserving owner authority, and the change is consumed repeatedly by the same or new actors rather than creating new authority.

The holdout change matches the scoped-capital pattern from the training evidence. Following the infrastructure-promotion-rule (T8), H6 inherits mature mechanism (native configuration already exists), adds only the smallest owner-local read-only projection (a narrow network capability/currentness view), and leaves route selection/effects and native evidence with the Agent. This is exactly the bounded owner-local projection stage, not a promoted shared semantic boundary. It does not create a central capability registry (avoiding the T1/T6 anti-patterns). The trigger is 'repeatedly reconstruct route affordances' — analogous to T4's repeated manual joining and T7's repeated human attention, which both produced capital. However, unlike T4 and T7 where multiple owners or formal evaluation independently consumed the same relation semantics, H6 is a single-owner projection for fresh Agents in one context (workstation network), and no second independent consumer or repeated responsible ownership beyond that context is demonstrated. Cross-owner generality is not shown, so it is useful at a bounded/local scope rather than demonstrated broad transferable capital. This is consistent with observed outcomes 3 and 8 (SCOPED_CAPITAL) for the bounded projection/no-promotion cases, and does not meet the TRANSFERRED_CAPITAL bar of reliable repeated responsibility across independent consumers or a stable evidenced multi-owner scope.

H7 carries the Infrastructure Promotion Rule (from T8) into a heterogeneous set of later architecture/owner decisions as a fixed prompt prior. T8 itself is labeled observed outcome 8 = SCOPED_CAPITAL, meaning the rule was useful only at a bounded/local scope and was NOT demonstrated as broad transferable capital. H7 explicitly depends on an unproven generalization ('if the historical rule generalizes'), adds no new owner facts, and admits it may bias different model families differently. The evidence shows the rule was scoped—not elevated to transferred status. Applying it as a prior across heterogeneous decisions inherits exactly that bounded scope: it is a local/option-value guardrail, not independently re-consumed as stable transferable capital, since a fixed prompt prior is a configuration choice, not evidence of independent later consumption. Therefore SCOPED_CAPITAL matches the closest supported regularity and avoids over-claiming transfer of a rule whose own outcome was scoped.
